name: Tusk ACT1
author: zaman-emm
source_notes: AI-generated pixel-art fan-art adaptation by zaman-emm. Final frames were generated with Krea (GPT Image 2.6) from the submitter's references and assembled, cleaned, and validated with the repository's hatch-pet-v2 scripts. References were used for character fidelity only and are not uploaded: a pixel-art Tusk ACT1 the submitter generated in Figma Make from Hirohiko Araki's official Tusk ACT1 art, a fan-made Tusk ACT1 turnaround sheet, third-party fan art, and official anime stills. Tusk ACT1 is from JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 7: Steel Ball Run by Hirohiko Araki.
description: A timid, plushie-cute Tusk ACT1 pixel-art Codex pet that floats with dangling heart charms, with nine animation states and 16 whole-body look directions.
